epic: Epic: Notification System. As a user, I want notifications for important events so that I stay informed. ACs: in-app center, email, push, preferences, batch digest, 90-day retention.
experiments: E-022 ONAYLANDI (notification latency 120ms p95). All ACs measured except batch digest which is [HYPOTHESIS].
architecture: Event-driven: Kafka → Notification Service → Channel Adapters. Redis queue. PostgreSQL prefs/history.
